title: classifyResourceHost
responsibility: Classify a computer's resource sample as offline, overloaded, busy or ok for placement

inputs.name: classifyResourceHost.host
inputs.description: One computer's latest Harness resource snapshot, workload and launcher state; a null snapshot means it never reported.

inputs.name: classifyResourceHost.policy
inputs.description: Stale limit and reserve rules; the defaults mirror the Tracker placement thresholds.

inputs.name: classifyResourceHost.now
inputs.description: Current time in milliseconds, used to age the snapshot.

outputs.name: classifyResourceHost
outputs.description: Offline, overloaded, busy or ok, with the reasons and the sample age in milliseconds (null when never reported).
